title: Bagh-Chal Deluxe: Tiger and Goat
bannerAlt: Bagh-Chal Deluxe: Tiger and Goat
description: Nepal’s traditional tiger and goat game in a complete Deluxe edition: a carved three-dimensional board, 44 puzzles in a campaign, 14 hands-on lessons, five computer levels or a friend, a daily challenge, and Auto Play to watch and learn. Fills the whole screen in portrait and landscape. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Golden Sling Deluxe
bannerAlt: Golden Sling Deluxe: pull, aim, release, guard the harvest
description: A paper-cut diorama of four seasons: 32 fields, four guardian bosses, a carved slingshot and birds raiding the crop. Pull back, aim and release to scare them off before the harvest is gone, with wind, combos and a Harvest Journal to fill. Works in portrait and landscape, with a Rules page and Auto Play to watch and learn. Free, works offline.

title: Word Game Deluxe
bannerAlt: Word Game Deluxe: a bridge of opposites, a net for synonyms
description: A word adventure for every age, from the alphabet read aloud to professional vocabulary. Look any word up in a built-in dictionary and thesaurus that works offline, build a bridge of opposites and cast a net for synonyms across 30 levels each, then keep going with more than seventy puzzles including analogies, your own word lists, a Word Garden that grows as you learn, graded reading, a Speech Lab and a Start Here path for beginners. Choose an age group and a learning level and the words follow. Fills the screen in portrait and landscape, with Auto Play to watch and learn. No account, works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Solitaire Deluxe
bannerAlt: Solitaire Deluxe: The most comfortable way to play solitaire
description: Six solitaire games in real 3D: Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid, TriPeaks and Golf, with winnable deals, hints that explain themselves, unlimited undo, daily deals and big-print, left-handed and one-hand comfort settings.

title: Carrom Deluxe
bannerAlt: Carrom Deluxe: Premium 3D carrom with real physics
description: A real-time 3D carrom board with a physics engine written from scratch: powder friction, rebounds and spin. Full international rules, five computer levels plus Adaptive, twenty lessons, a ten stage campaign, daily challenge, doubles and pass and play, replay, and boards, powders, coins and strikers to unlock. Works offline.

title: Arcforge Sudoku Deluxe
bannerAlt: Sudoku Deluxe: Hand-crafted Sudoku in 3D, with a coach that teaches
description: Seven Sudoku variants on an engraved 3D board: a library of over 1,500 puzzles, each proven to have one solution and graded by the techniques it needs. A coach explains the next logical step, a Learn path teaches every technique from Full House to forcing chains, and Watch and Learn plays whole puzzles for you.

title: Dominoes Deluxe
bannerAlt: Dominoes Deluxe: Seven classic domino games on one beautiful 3D table
description: Cuban Partners, Doble Nueve, Block, Draw, All Fives, Mexican Train and Chicken Foot, each with its own rules page, against computer opponents at five levels plus Adaptive that remember every tile and read every pass. Ivory, ebony or rosewood tiles on felt, walnut or marble, hints with reasons, a live coach, ten lessons, Watch & Learn, a daily challenge and statistics. Works offline.

title: Go Deluxe
bannerAlt: Go Deluxe: Learn and play Go on a lit 3D board
description: A teaching-first Go with a 3D kaya board, ten computer levels, twelve lessons, over 150 life-and-death problems, a daily problem and game review.

title: Chess Deluxe
bannerAlt: Chess Deluxe: Beautiful 3D chess that teaches you to win
description: A real-time 3D chess board with carved pieces, ten computer levels, a coach that explains your mistakes, 36 lessons, hundreds of rated puzzles, a daily puzzle and a full game review. Works offline.

title: Ludo Deluxe
bannerAlt: Ludo Deluxe: Calm, beautiful Ludo, Pachisi and Royal Cross
description: Roll real dice out of a leather cup onto a lit 3D board and race glossy tokens around the cross. Three classic games in one app (Ludo, Pachisi with cowrie shells and Royal Cross with two dice), computer players with four levels and five personalities, nine lessons, Watch & Learn, a Cup, a League season, a Daily Challenge and 28 trophies. Works offline.

title: Cricket Chase Deluxe
bannerAlt: Cricket Chase Deluxe: Floodlit chases with real ball physics
description: A premium night cricket game: a 60-situation Chase Table, batting and bowling, field setting, a daily chase, an eight-team cup, super overs, lessons and a coach, in a real-time 3D stadium with swing, spin, seam and wind.

title: Mahjong Deluxe
bannerAlt: Mahjong Deluxe: Riichi and Hong Kong mahjong, played like a pro
description: A full four-player mahjong table in real-time 3D: engraved tiles, a wall that builds in front of you, dice and a dealer compass. Choose Riichi (Japanese) or Hong Kong rules, play four computer levels from Beginner to Master, and learn with a coach that grades every discard and explains shape, waits and scoring in plain words. Lessons, a daily hand, unlimited practice puzzles, a scoring calculator, a fan and yaku reference, replays and Watch and Learn. Score only, works offline.

title: Backgammon Deluxe
bannerAlt: Backgammon Deluxe: Dice, strategy and nerve
description: A premium 3D backgammon table with the doubling cube, match play and the Turkish and Greek table games Tavla, Portes, Plakoto and Fevga. A strong computer opponent, a coach, lessons, puzzles and a World Tour.

title: Arcforge Mancala Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Mancala Deluxe: Oware and Kalah on a real 3D board
description: A premium 3D mancala with physical seeds on a carved wooden board, Oware and Kalah rule sets, a strong computer opponent, lessons, a puzzle campaign, a daily challenge, game review and heritage chapters.

title: Arcforge Minesweeper Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Minesweeper Deluxe: Tactile 3D tiles. Logic that explains itself
description: A premium 3D minesweeper with boards that never need a guess, a coach that explains every deduction, five grids (square, hexagon, triangle, octagon and wrap-around), a 61-puzzle Deduction Academy, a daily challenge, records, trophies and six themes.

title: Arcforge Mini Golf Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Mini Golf Deluxe: Premium 3D mini golf: 54 holes, portals, windmills and ghosts
description: Slingshot-putt round 54 holes on six themed courses in a real-time 3D world. Slopes, ramps, sand, ice, water, portals, windmills and pendulums, a coach that explains its putts, ghost replays, daily challenges, lessons and up to four players. Works offline.

title: Arcforge Darts Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Darts Deluxe: Aim. Flick. Check out
description: A premium 3D darts game: a flick-to-throw control, 501, Cricket, Around the Clock and Killer, eight computer levels, seven tournaments, a daily challenge, checkout coaching and Darts School.

title: Arcforge Snooker Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Snooker Deluxe: Snooker, 8-ball and 9-ball with real physics
description: A premium 3D cue-sports table: snooker (full-size and a short six-red game), 8-ball and 9-ball with true rules, spin and cushions modelled by a physics engine. Six computer opponents, a three-chapter campaign, 24 solved trick shots, drills, lessons, a daily challenge, Watch and Learn, trophies and statistics.

title: Arcforge Reversi Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Reversi Deluxe: Glossy 3D discs and a genuinely hard opponent
description: The classic game of flipping discs in real-time 3D: two-sided discs that turn over in a rolling wave, rich board materials, eight computer levels with a top level that solves the ending perfectly, lessons, verified puzzles, named openings, a daily challenge and full game review with an evaluation graph. Works offline.

title: Arcforge Xiangqi Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Xiangqi Deluxe: Chinese chess in real-time 3D that teaches you to win
description: A real-time 3D Xiangqi board with carved men, eight computer levels, a coach that grades your moves, 14 lessons, a 90-puzzle campaign, a daily challenge, an opening trainer and full game review. Works offline.

title: Arcforge Shogi Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Shogi Deluxe: Japanese chess in 3D with a coach and 190 mating puzzles
description: Real-time 3D shogi with wedge-shaped wooden pieces on a kaya board, eight computer levels, sixteen hands-on lessons, 190 checkmate puzzles with a daily challenge, a castle and opening trainer, a coach that rates your moves and a full game review. Works offline.

title: Arcforge Checkers Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Checkers Deluxe: Four rule sets, real 3D, a strong engine
description: The complete draughts app: American Checkers, Russian, Brazilian and International Draughts played by their real rules on beautiful 3D boards, against a strong engine with eight levels. Learn with 22 interactive lessons, solve about 190 puzzles and a Daily Shot, explore openings with engine scores and review every game move by move. Works offline, no account.

title: Arcforge Snakes Ladders Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Snakes Ladders Deluxe: The tabletop dice race
description: A premium 3D snakes and ladders table with tumbling dice, slithering snakes, charms, mystery squares, six computer personalities, a twelve-stop Journey, a daily race, foresight trials and an Almanac on the history of the game.

title: Hanoi Tower: Brass & Lacquer
bannerAlt: Hanoi Tower: Brass & Lacquer: the tower puzzle in 3D
description: The classic tower puzzle as a brass and lacquer object in 3D: 48 towers on three to five pegs, the Rail and Ring rules, 12 lessons on the mathematics, a daily tower, free build, exact Par for every puzzle and Auto Play that explains each move. Works offline, no account.

title: Huarong Gate: Lacquer Generals
bannerAlt: Huarong Gate: a lacquered 3D sliding-block puzzle with painted generals
description: The classic Huarong Road escape puzzle as a lacquered rosewood tray with painted generals, drawn in real-time 3D. Twelve chapters of 240 graded puzzles with a par proved by exhaustive search, eight lessons, a daily puzzle, Endless mode, hints that explain and Auto Play that thinks aloud. Works offline.

title: Kite Duel: Festival Sky Fight
bannerAlt: Kite Duel: two fighting kites cross their threads in a festival sky
description: A fighting-kite sim in six 3D festival skies. Real wind and gusts, a kite that is a real sail, a thread with tension, sag and wear, and crossings where angle, grit and the draw decide who is cut. Thirty bouts, eight lessons, a daily duel, a hangar of kites and threads, and Auto Play where a master explains each move. Works offline.

title: Cornhole Circuit: 3D Bag Toss
bannerAlt: Cornhole Circuit: 3D Bag Toss: a bag-toss tournament from backyard to arena
description: A bag-toss tournament in real-time 3D: swipe to pitch at a real-size slanted board, climb a five-event circuit from a backyard cup to an arena final, play quick matches, lessons and a daily board, and watch Auto Play explain its moves.

title: Pocket Gridiron: QB Playbook
bannerAlt: Pocket Gridiron: QB Playbook: a 3D quarterback game about reading the defence
description: A quarterback game in real-time 3D: call plays from a 21-play playbook, read a defence that adapts to you, and throw with a bullet, standard or touch pass. A season, 44 challenges, a daily drive, a film room and Watch & Learn with a coach that explains every read. Works offline.

title: Top Clash: Spin Battle Arena
bannerAlt: Top Clash: Spin Battle Arena: heritage tops battle in 3D stadiums
description: A spinning-top battle arena with real spin physics: wind the cord, aim and clash six heritage tops in three 3D stadiums, win eight-player cups, learn in eight lessons, build your own top in the garage and watch Auto Play explain every move.

title: Kendama Dojo: 3D Skill Toy
bannerAlt: Kendama Dojo: 3D Skill Toy: A 3D kendama with real string-and-ball physics
description: Lift the ball with a flick, slide a cup or the spike under it, and hold the catch. Thirty tricks in six belts, lessons, a timed Flow Run, a daily trick and Auto Play that explains its moves. A lifelike hand, lacquered ken and ball, three rooms.

title: Shinny Pond Hockey
bannerAlt: Shinny Pond Hockey: Real-time 3D pond hockey you flick with one thumb
description: Skate a frozen pond in real-time 3D: one thumb steers, a swipe shoots, and the puck banks off snow and boulders. One-on-one or two-on-two against five computer levels, a 24-stop circuit across eight ponds, 24 skill drills, a daily shot, lessons and Auto Play.

title: Gangline: Sled Dog Racing
bannerAlt: Gangline: Sled Dog Racing: lead a 3D dog team through a season of stage races
description: Lead a team of real 3D sled dogs through six stage races: set the gait, lean the sled through bends, choose a branch at forks and care for every dog at each checkpoint. Night stages under the aurora, a kennel and shop, Quick Race, a Daily Run, Musher School and Auto Play. Works offline.

title: Marble & Thread: Tilt Maze
bannerAlt: Marble & Thread: Tilt Maze: A wooden tilt labyrinth with a real rolling marble and a red thread
description: Roll a cobalt-and-gold marble through 48 lacquered-wood mazes with pits cut through the floor, ice, felt and a red thread that winds back when you retrace. Eight lessons, a daily board, free build with a seed, ghost runs of your fastest times and Auto Play that explains its plan.

title: Pottery Deluxe: Wheel & Kiln
bannerAlt: Pottery Deluxe: Wheel & Kiln: Throw, trim, glaze and fire real clay on a spinning wheel
description: A calm craft simulation. The clay is a real model of rings that keep their volume, so thinning a wall makes the pot grow and widening a belly makes it sink. Take commissions from clients, follow the dotted outline, trim, glaze and fire in the kiln, and keep your best pots on a shelf. Studio School, a daily commission and an Auto Play potter who explains every move are included.

title: Origami Crease: Paper Studio
bannerAlt: Origami Crease: Paper Studio: fold real paper in 3D
description: A paper folding studio with a real fold engine: six guided models up to reverse folds, a Studio that folds anything, twelve crease-pattern puzzles with a daily pattern, nine lessons, Auto Play that explains each fold, eight papers and four desks. Works offline, no account.

title: Sand & Net: Beach Volleyball
bannerAlt: Sand & Net: Beach Volleyball: Swipe to serve, set and spike
description: Premium real-time 3D beach volleyball: aim serves and spikes with a swipe, time digs and blocks, climb a five-stop circuit, learn in the academy, play the daily challenge, Auto Play or two players on one screen.

title: Uprights: Rugby Kicker
bannerAlt: Uprights: Rugby Kicker: read the wind, set the strike, hold your nerve
description: A 3D rugby kicking game with a real physics model: place kicks and drop goals in wind, rain and gusts. Read the flags, aim off the posts, choose the strike on the ball and hold your nerve. A six-cup career against rival kickers, thirty challenges, a daily set, ten lessons in Kicking School, and a Watch & Learn coach that plays and explains every kick. Works offline, no account.

title: Rink Master: Lawn Bowls
bannerAlt: Rink Master: Lawn Bowls: curve it, weigh it, draw to the jack
description: A premium bowling-green simulation: biased bowls with curved-path physics, line and weight control, six greens with their own pace and slope, a six-venue career against twelve bowlers, head puzzles, a daily challenge, lessons and a coach that explains every shot. Works offline, no account.

title: Bonsai Atelier: Prune & Shape
bannerAlt: Bonsai Atelier: Prune & Shape: grow, prune and wire a living 3D bonsai
description: A calm workshop for training miniature trees. A maple, juniper or pine grows in real time in a lit 3D studio through the seasons. Cut, pinch and wire it toward one of seven classic styles, then show it to a judge who scores seven things and explains each. Twelve commissions, a free Studio, a Daily Tree, a Gallery with an exhibition room, and an Auto Play coach that explains every move. Works offline, no account.

title: Kubb Tour: 3D Lawn Game
bannerAlt: Kubb Tour: 3D Lawn Game: topple the blocks, take the king
description: The Swedish lawn game in real-time 3D: pull and sweep to throw tumbling batons, topple the kubbs on a real-size lawn, throw your fallen kubbs back into the field and fell the king. A tour from an apple garden to a floodlit championship lawn, eight rivals, six lessons, a daily lawn and Auto Play that explains its moves.

title: Shuttle Strike: 3D Badminton
bannerAlt: Shuttle Strike: 3D Badminton
description: Shuttle Strike is badminton you play with one finger. Your racket floats over a glowing ring on a lit court; the ring runs for the shuttle, and you decide every stroke with a swipe. Swipe long and smooth for a high clear, flick short for a drop, swipe fast overhead for a smash, tap to block. Aim by angling your swipe: a glowing arc shows where the shuttle will land before you let go. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Longball Nights
bannerAlt: Longball Nights
description: Longball Nights is a real-time 3D batting game for your phone and tablet. A pitching machine on the mound, a bat in your hands, six ballparks under the lights, and a ball that flies the way real balls fly. There are no people in this game by design. The machine throws, you swing, and the stands are a glittering field of phone lights and floodlights. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Swish Circuit: Hoop Shots
bannerAlt: Swish Circuit: Hoop Shots
description: You are standing on a painted line with a ball in your hands and a hoop that does not care how you feel. Press, drag up, let go. The ball leaves your fingers with real spin, climbs, turns over and either whispers through the net or clangs off the iron. Swish Circuit is all of that and nothing else: a basketball shooting game built around one gesture and a ball that behaves. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Pinfall League: 3D Bowling
bannerAlt: Pinfall League: 3D Bowling
description: Roll it the way the lane wants it rolled. Pinfall League is a bowling game built on a physics engine: the ball skids on oil, bites on dry wood and hooks into the pocket, and the pins lean, topple, slide and knock each other over. Ten-pin with true scoring: strikes, spares and the tenth frame, up to a perfect 300. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Maple Ring Crokinole
bannerAlt: Maple Ring Crokinole
description: Pull back, let go, and listen to the clack. Maple Ring is crokinole for the phone in your hand: a round maple board, eight brass pegs, and a small dark hole in the middle that is worth twenty. You flick wooden discs across the lacquer, knock your rival's discs into the ditch, and try to leave your own sitting pretty on the rings. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Quillgrid Crosswords
bannerAlt: Quillgrid Crosswords
description: Quillgrid sets a fresh crossword every time you ask, and lays it out on a lit walnut desk where every letter is an ivory tile with some weight to it. TODAY - A daily puzzle that is the same for everyone, bigger as the week goes on, with a streak and a calendar of the last two weeks. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Pebble & Broom Curling
bannerAlt: Pebble & Broom Curling
description: Walk onto the ice. Pebble & Broom is a curling game built around the two things that make the sport: the line and weight you choose, and the sweeping that rescues it. Stones slide on pebbled ice, slow down, and curl more as they die. Brushing warms the pebble: a swept stone runs further and straighter. Every stone carries its own tiny quirk, so no two throws match. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Top Bins: Free Kick Deluxe
bannerAlt: Top Bins: Free Kick Deluxe
description: Top Bins is a real-time 3D free kick and penalty game for your phone and tablet. Put a finger on the screen, swipe up, and bend the ball over the wall, past the keeper and into the top corner. Gravity, air drag and spin are simulated. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Rackline: Four in a Row
bannerAlt: Rackline: Four in a Row
description: Rackline is the classic game of dropping stones into a standing rack to line up four, made with real care: a real-time 3D rack, a computer opponent you can trust, and a full set of ways to learn. Eight computer levels from Sprout to Grandmaster, plus an Adaptive opponent that follows your rating. The strongest levels search deeply and then solve the ending perfectly. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Starleap: Chinese Checkers
bannerAlt: Starleap: Chinese Checkers
description: Starleap is a table of glass marbles under a night sky, and one simple idea: jump. Step to the next hole, or hop over any marble beside you into the gap behind it, then hop again, and again, in the same turn. Line your marbles up with a hole between each and you have a ladder that carries a marble clear across the board. Your rivals can climb it too. Build it, use it, or break theirs. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Hearts Royale: Card Table
bannerAlt: Hearts Royale: Card Table
description: Hearts Royale is the classic game of avoiding hearts and the Queen of Spades, dealt on a lit 3D card table with opponents that really think. Four players, 52 cards, one goal: take as few points as you can. Pass three cards, follow suit, duck the dangerous tricks, dump the Queen of Spades on someone else, and keep an eye out for a rival shooting the moon. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Jigsaw Atelier
bannerAlt: Jigsaw Atelier
description: Jigsaw Atelier is a jigsaw studio for people who love a calm, beautiful puzzle. Real 3D pieces lie on a lit wooden table, every picture is painted fresh for you, and nothing ever interrupts the quiet: no accounts, no tracking, and it works fully offline. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Rat & Elephant: Jungle Chess
bannerAlt: Rat & Elephant: Jungle Chess
description: Rat & Elephant is Jungle (Dou Shou Qi), the animal-rank board game where the smallest creature can topple the largest, made with care for your phone or tablet. Eight carved animals a side, two rivers, rune traps and a den to reach: simple to learn, deep to master. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Millstone Morris
bannerAlt: Millstone Morris
description: Millstone Morris is the family of mill games on a board you want to touch: Three, Six, Nine and Twelve Men's Morris, played with carved men shaped like small millstones on walnut, slate, oak or marble, with brass inlay and warm light. Play any of the four games against six computer opponents, from a Novice that overlooks threats to a Grandmaster that is hard to trick. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Gridlight: Picture Logic
bannerAlt: Gridlight: Picture Logic
description: Gridlight turns number clues into pictures. Read the numbers beside each row and column, decide which cells belong, and fill them in. Finish, and the flat grid does something no paper puzzle can: the picture lifts out of its tray as a relief of lit glass, and you can turn it with a finger. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Okey Lounge: 3D Tile Rummy
bannerAlt: Okey Lounge: 3D Tile Rummy
description: Okey is the tile game of Turkish homes and tea houses: four players, 106 tiles, and one wild tile that changes every deal. Okey Lounge sets the table in real 3D and teaches you to play it well. Three computer players sit around a cloth with a hand-drawn medallion. Tiles are lit, bevelled and tumble when they are dealt. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Peg Solitaire Salon
bannerAlt: Peg Solitaire Salon
description: Peg Solitaire Salon is the old jumping puzzle set on a table you want to touch. A warm lamp, a carved plate lined with brass, turned pegs of wood, polished brass or blown glass that leap over their neighbours with real weight, and a brass-and-felt tray that catches every peg you capture. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Scopa Salotto Deluxe
bannerAlt: Scopa Salotto Deluxe
description: Scopa Salotto Deluxe brings the Italian card game of sweeping the table to your phone with care: real-time 3D cards on a lamp-lit table, a computer opponent that really counts cards, and everything you need to learn and improve. Two, three or four players, with partnerships in the four-player game. - Scopone Scientifico, the classic partnership game with the whole pack dealt out. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Shepherd's Whistle
bannerAlt: Shepherd's Whistle
description: Shepherd's Whistle puts you in the paws of a border collie on five hill farms, from spring pasture to snowbound fells. Drag a thumb to steer, creep, trot or gallop, and use four tools: a shoving bark, a steadying whistle, the hard stare called eye, and lie down to rest. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Clatterbox: Shut the Box
bannerAlt: Clatterbox: Shut the Box
description: Clatterbox is a shut-the-box game made with care: a walnut case of hinged ivory tiles, a felt tray, and a pair of dice that really tumble. Roll, shut the tiles that add up to your total, and keep going until nothing fits. Fewer points left open is better, and shutting the whole box is the prize. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Aurora Ski Jump
bannerAlt: Aurora Ski Jump
description: Aurora Ski Jump is a ski jumping game built on a real flight model. Gravity, snow friction, lift, drag, wind and gusts decide every metre, and one finger flies the whole jump. Hold to crouch down the ice track. Flick upward on the beat at the edge. In the air, drag up for a steeper angle and sideways to keep the skis level. Tap in the last half second for the telemark. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Soapbox Rally: Downhill Racing
bannerAlt: Soapbox Rally: Downhill Racing
description: Soapbox Rally is a premium downhill racing game with no engine at all. Your speed comes from the hill, and every bend, surface and setup choice decides how fast you finish. Drive with one thumb. Slide left and right to steer, slide down to brake, hold still on the straights and the kart tucks in for speed. A fast, honest physics model gives each kart real weight, tyre grip and slide. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Offshore: Surf Contest Tour
bannerAlt: Offshore: Surf Contest Tour
description: Offshore is a surf contest tour in a live 3D ocean. Ride twelve of the world's most famous waves, face three rivals in every heat, and let five judges decide who goes through. Drag your thumb to carve the face. Draw S-turns to pump for speed, snap off the lip, cut back to the foam, launch airs and spin them, and slot into the tube when a bowl stands the wave up. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Spin Circuit Table Tennis
bannerAlt: Spin Circuit Table Tennis
description: Spin Circuit is table tennis built around one gesture: the swipe. Let the ball bounce, swipe up the screen, and your paddle meets it. How fast you swipe picks the stroke, which way you lean aims it, and a bow in your swipe puts sidespin on the ball. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Hnefatafl: The King's Hall
bannerAlt: Hnefatafl: The King's Hall
description: Pull up a bench in the king's hall. Hnefatafl is the old Norse game of the hunted king: a small band of defenders and their king against twice as many attackers, played on a carved board by candlelight. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Tangram Atelier: Wood & Glass
bannerAlt: Tangram Atelier: Wood & Glass
description: Tangram Atelier is a quiet workshop for dissection puzzles. A walnut table, a cream cutting board with a figure cut into it, and a set of pieces you can really feel: pale maple, dark ebony, jewel glass, soft felt or glossy lacquer. Fill the dark figure so nothing overlaps and nothing is left over. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Topspin Tennis Deluxe 3D
bannerAlt: Topspin Tennis Deluxe 3D
description: Real-time 3D tennis for your phone or tablet, built around one idea: the ball does what a ball really does. Every shot is simulated. Air drag slows it, spin bends it, topspin dips and kicks, slice stays low and skids, and the bounce depends on the court under it. Play hard court, slow red clay, fast grass or indoor carpet and feel four different games. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Brasslock: Crack the Code
bannerAlt: Brasslock: Crack the Code
description: Brasslock is the classic code-breaking game, also known as Bulls and Cows, built as a heavy brass cryptex on a leather desk. Turn the dials to set your guess, press Try, and read the answer in studs: gold for a right symbol in the right place, silver for a right symbol in the wrong place. Crack the sealed code before the ledger runs out. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Soroban Dojo: Abacus Mind
bannerAlt: Soroban Dojo: Abacus Mind
description: Soroban Dojo is a training hall for the Japanese soroban and the Chinese suanpan. A real-time 3D abacus of lacquered beads on a rosewood frame sits in front of you; drag a bead to the beam to count it, away to release it, and hear it click. Works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Earth Atlas: Picture Games
bannerAlt: Earth Atlas: Picture Games
description: Geography games on real maps. See a country on its map and flag, a river’s path or a mountain’s country, then tap the city, animal, river, mountain, climate or neighbour that belongs to it. Eleven games: Capital Cities is free to play and each of the other ten is a one-time purchase, with no subscription, and has a free 90-second preview in the browser demo. Works offline.

title: Snug: Shape Fit Puzzle
bannerAlt: Snug: Shape Fit Puzzle
description: A relaxed shape-fit puzzle. Drag shapes from the tray onto the board, fill a whole row or column and it pops, and keep going until nothing fits. Daily goals and a streak to keep you coming back. Free to play.
